# Model OH window modes and transitions separately from device type

## Platform difference

Window state, device category and orientation are separate inputs; an OH floating window is not necessarily the app's media miniwindow.

## Implementation

Kazumi adds PC/2in1 detection and maps fullscreen to maximize/recover there. PiliPlus uses native free-window events to exclude normal desktop windows from its miniwindow scale and restricts only a problematic manual-PiP path. Simple Live experiments with waiting for orientation before fullscreen state, then deliberately restores immediate layout/letterboxing. NipaPlay bounds unanswered SystemChrome calls; Simple Live uses a manual-overlay fallback when exiting fullscreen.

## Applicability

Window policies depend on product and embedding versions. The Simple Live reversal is a transition-design choice, not a contradiction to hide or a universal timing recipe.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

Do not infer PC host-toolchain support from app support for PC devices. A channel timeout can occur even if the visual operation applied; distinguish requested and observed window state. Keep listeners scoped to the native lifecycle.

## Verification

Test phone, tablet/free-window and 2in1 modes, entry/exit races, system bar restoration, manual/automatic PiP and native callback loss.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
